description: A pencil lies diagonally across a square sheet, its sharpened tip pointing down-left onto the page. The paper outline opens at the upper right around the pencil, whose opposite end has a short cap.
A rectangular ballot box has a shallow sloping top with a horizontal slot. A tall blank voting slip leans slightly right as it enters the slot, above a rounded front face.
A side-view bus has a rounded roof, long horizontal window division and two circular wheels. A tall pole rises from the body, carrying a rectangular flag with a notched fly edge.
Three head-and-shoulder figures gather beneath a large folded banner. The left figure is largest, the right is smallest, and the banner extends rightward into a pointed notched tail.
Three unequal vertical bars rise from a shared horizontal baseline, each aligned above a person bust. The central bar is tallest and the left shortest, while the three figures are equal in size.
A raised index finger points toward a small square selection box at the upper left. Two horizontal rectangular option fields sit to the right, while the hand extends downward with a bent thumb.
A front-facing figure stands behind a broad podium top, with a circular head and rounded shoulders. A diagonal sash crosses the torso, and two sloping podium sides descend beneath the ledge.
A front-facing woman stands behind a podium, wearing a diagonal sash across her torso. Center-parted hair curls outward beside the head, while the podium has a wide top and two sloping sides.
A right-facing elephant has a broad rounded back above a horizontal body division. Two blocky legs frame a rectangular opening, and a long trunk curls upward at the far right.
A large circular pie chart on the left is divided into three unequal sectors. Two equal head-and-shoulder figures are stacked vertically along its right side, forming a compact results diagram.
Two head-and-shoulder figures are stacked vertically beside a horizontal bar chart. Each figure aligns with one outlined bar extending right from a common upright axis, with the upper bar longer.
A front-facing person stands behind a tall tapered lectern with a broad top ledge. The round head and arched shoulders rise above it, and a small trapezoidal plaque marks the front.
Two square voting boxes are stacked vertically, with a cross inside the lower box. A pencil angles down-left from the upper right, its sharpened tip beside the marked option.
A long rounded rectangular eraser tilts upward to the right, resting on a horizontal surface line. A diagonal seam separates its shorter lower end from the larger upper section.
A graduation cap has a broad diamond-shaped top above a curved cylindrical band. A tassel hangs from the left corner on a straight cord, ending in a rounded pendant.
A rounded rectangular bookcase contains two shelves of books. The upper row has several upright spines and one leaning volume, while the lower row combines tall and short books.
A circular pie chart has two separated wedges on its right side. A large remaining sector wraps around the left and lower edges, with open gaps separating the quarter-circle and smaller slice.
A front-facing person holds an open book across the chest, with a round head above curved shoulders. Two small hands grip the outer edges, and the pages meet at a central vertical fold.
A front-facing backpack has a domed top, small carrying loop and flat bottom. A rounded front pocket is divided by a horizontal zipper line, with smaller pockets projecting from both sides.
An upright bell has a domed crown and flared lower rim. A rounded clapper hangs beneath the rim, joined by a short stem to a small circular pull below.
An apple rests on a closed book laid horizontally. The apple has a curved stem and pointed leaf, while the book shows a short page mark and rounded spine at the right.
A two-handled trophy cup stands on a horizontally closed book. The cup narrows to a curved stem and broad foot, while the book has a rounded right end and a short page mark at left.
A symmetrical school building has a tall rounded central tower topped by a flag. A circular clock or window sits above an arched entrance, with two short window marks on each lower side wing.
Two tall rectangular locker doors stand side by side within a shared frame. Each door has paired horizontal vents near the top and bottom, with a small handle mark between them.
A rounded two-door locker cabinet stands on short feet. A central seam divides the doors, each with a short horizontal upper label slot and a vertical handle below.
A standing teacher occupies the lower-left side of a large rectangular blackboard. The figure has a curved hairline, straight torso and divided legs, while the board outline opens behind the teacher.
A broad desk on two splayed legs supports a stack of two books on the left and a lamp on the right. The lamp's bent stem carries a tilted shade aimed toward the books.
An upright light bulb has a rounded glass envelope tapering toward a short socket. A Y-shaped filament rises inside from the base, and five short rays spread above and beside the bulb.
A front-facing owl wears a diamond-topped graduation cap with a tassel hanging left. Large round eyes sit above a pointed beak, while curved wing lines frame the rounded body.
A large central graduate wears a mortarboard and a pointed collar, with a curved band across the upper head. Two smaller head-and-shoulder figures flank the graduate on either side.
